sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety for the 2026-07-27 UTC current-week window and recommended ORCA-bench with OSReward and Copyable Context safeguards as backups.
Main agent read the arXiv abstract, PDF full text, construction pipeline, scoring rubric, result tables, ablations, failure cases, appendix metrics, and public dataset redirect.
Deep read extracted environment design, task parameterization, 0-3 rubric scoring, RCA metrics, code-access ablation, telemetry failure analysis, and production-readiness boundaries.
Article flags internal task-count inconsistency, public fixed testbed limitations, single harness and prompt scope, model-version drift, and lack of action-loop evaluation.
Article is pure Markdown with more than 5000 real Chinese characters, self-contained TL;DR, tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid, with no external image embeds.
